snippet.title: Pokémon Starwish – Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
#PokemonStarwish #PokemonFangame #Pokemon
Return to Hoenn six years later in a fully voice-acted Pokémon adventure where a forgotten wish awakens.

We grew up exploring this region — chasing dreams of becoming stronger together. For many of us, Pokémon was where our journeys began. Now we return — older, stronger, carrying the memories that shaped who we became.

Pokémon Starwish is a fan-made continuation inspired by Pokémon Emerald, telling a new emotional story about friendship, loss, and the consequences of a wish that should never have been granted.

When a mysterious operation begins and steel shadows spread across the region, the past resurfaces — and a promise once made beneath a setting sun may decide Hoenn’s future.

Featuring:
• Full voice acting throughout the adventure
• A story-driven cinematic experience
• A new post-Emerald narrative set six years later
• Familiar places, returning faces, and new mysteries waiting to unfold

And somewhere above Hoenn’s skies… the echo of a wish once saved still remains.

🎮 The demo version is now available — experience the first glimpse of Starwish and begin the journey yourself.
🔗 https://zamius.wixstudio.com/pokemonstarwish 🔗

Join our Discord community for news on the game and more!
🔗 https://discord.gg/2f8JwnM49G
—
Pokémon Starwish is a non-profit fan project created out of love for the Pokémon series.
Pokémon is © Nintendo, Game Freak, and The Pokémon Company.
